_note: The mission board. Instead of one pending raid, the player sees a few missions and CHOOSES one — erring toward what they're suited for, or stretching into a harder one because of its SPOILS (the self-correcting loop: your weakness points you at the content that fixes it). A mission = a threat (counter-stat) + a difficulty (loss/reward multipliers) + a reward focus (biases the faked haul, and is hinted up front). Escalating quest CHAINS are deferred — first prove the single choice is fun.
